committed graph-only handover advances the snackbar epoch - aborts never do()
unreleased worker lease aborts the graph-only transition too()
preflight CancellationException - the deferred STILL resolves, with an abort()
candidate construction failure unwinds - Serving restored, shared db open, no strand()
graph-only handover - same database object, fresh graph lifetime store, next id()
